reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: New international rules for 4IR technologies
themes.definition: The fourth industrial revolution, including AI and robotization, is said to demand new international rules of conduct and multilateral solutions.
themes.inclusion: Include calls for new international rules or normative arrangements for AI and related technologies.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages mentioning AI only as a technology trend without rule-making demands.
themes.boundary_cases: Where the UN is named as central rule-definer, also code AI_UN_ROLE.

examples.quote: the impact of new technologies — on the economy, the work world and relations among States — will demand new rules of conduct at the international level

themes.label: UN central in defining technology rules
themes.definition: The UN should play a central role in defining rules for new technologies by providing compromise solutions safeguarding the public interest.
themes.inclusion: Include statements assigning the UN a central role in AI or tech governance.
themes.exclusion: Exclude governance calls not referencing the UN.
themes.boundary_cases: Generic UN centrality without technology context is not coded.

examples.quote: The UN must play a central role in defining them by providing compromise solutions capable of safeguard the public interest.

themes.label: Fourth industrial revolution as challenge and opportunity
themes.definition: The fourth industrial revolution including AI is framed as both a challenge and an opportunity, with effects on economy and work.
themes.inclusion: Include explicit challenge-and-opportunity framings of AI or 4IR.
themes.boundary_cases: Mention of impacts on the 'work world' may also support AI_ECONOMY_LABOR.

examples.quote: What is know called the fourth industrial revolution presents both a challenge and an opportunity.

value.rationale: A single Portuguese passage frames AI within the fourth industrial revolution as challenge and opportunity, and calls for new international rules with the UN at the centre.
